kind: P2G-10 limited read-only decision-support facts; not a P2G-20 Source Observation or Code Review Binding
question_boundary: Determine whether R06 evaluation, arithmetic, owner/lifetime and compatibility meanings can be resolved by adopted scope plus delegated ordinary-policy rules without inventing gameplay weights or later-R behavior.

observations.fact: Current SkillEffectDef uses fixed i32 amount fields and a typed Resources operation; no ValueExpr schema was found.
observations.decision_use: Existing literals must retain meaning while the selected R06 adds a typed expression path.

observations.fact: StatId/UnitStats contain Attack but no SpellPower; existing modifiers use saturating integer arithmetic and AttackIntervalMs is a distinct field.
observations.decision_use: R06 must add a distinct SpellPower authority and must not silently treat current saturation as new expression overflow policy.

observations.fact: Current battle-entry order is profile/weapon, GrowthStack, Permanent effects, owned enhancement modifiers, then HP. Growth is KillStack-only and enhancement levels are matched by base UUID before repeated modifier application.
observations.decision_use: Each input needs a single owner/site and actual-copy binding review; exact repair is P2G-20/GEX work.

observations.fact: WeaponCombatProfile owns cadence/delivery/damage type but no Attack or SpellPower contribution.
observations.decision_use: Weapon quantitative contribution is an R06 implementation delta, not an already existing value.

observations.fact: apply_weapon_profile replaces weapon behavior/cadence and scale_attack_interval_ms uses ceil division with positive inputs and a minimum one-millisecond result.
observations.decision_use: AttackSpeedPoints can preserve this canonical conversion without accelerating unrelated timers.

observations.fact: Damage inputs already materialize a DamageSourceSnapshot before later delivery/consumption.
observations.decision_use: R06 snapshot expressions preserve released-delivery immutability instead of re-reading mutable source stats.

observations.fact: R05 resources are keyed by typed owner/scope/lease/revision and R04 action queries distinguish different-attempt, unavailable, stale and not-settled results.
observations.decision_use: Value reads can reuse these identities and faults; expression evaluation must not mutate balances or fabricate unavailable results.

observations.fact: Current Certified power is a versioned weighted model over persistent combat profile inputs.
observations.decision_use: R06 connects truthful new quantitative inputs and invalidation but does not select new final weights reserved to R19.
